dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the dorsal ridge to the apex, forming a recurved profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological classification with a moderate pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Posteriorly directed incline of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The maximum pixel base width is approximately 1.4 times the maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broadly convex curvature fitting the anterior-dorsal boundary of the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, conical rostrum with a pixel length approximately equivalent to its basal thickness.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.
